full_judgment: "Now coming to the interpretation of section 135A of the Act it has been contended by Mr. Ruhul Amin that after the introduction of section 135A of the Act the law authorizes any firm after subrogation to realize the money on its behalf for the insurer has been repealed. While, on the other hand, it has been contended by the learned Advocate for the appellant that previous law was that both the insurer and the insured after subrogation could institute a suit. This amendment has not in any way taken away those rights either by implication of expressly rather this amendment has clarified the previous position. The learned Advocate for the appellant has relied on the following cases in support of his contention. The case of East and West Steamship Co. vs. Queensland Insurance Co.(4) and the case of Indian Trade and General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Union of India (5), and the learned Advocate for the respondent has relied on the following cases in support of his contention : the case of Santuram Hari vs. Trust of India Assurance Co., and another (6) the case of Textile and Yarn Ltd. vs. India National Steamship Co. Ltd (7) the case of Lala Kapurchand Godha and others vs. Mir Nawab Himayatalikhan Azamjah (8) and the case of Shah Mulji Deoji, a Firm vs. Union of India (9).
